passages.text: A song of ascents. Of Solomon.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sing this song while going up to Jerusalem.
Solomon wrote this song.

passages.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents by Solomon.
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD builds the house.
If the LORD does not build the house, the builders work for nothing.
The LORD protects the city.
If the LORD does not protect the city, the watchmen guard it for nothing.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ לֹא־ יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא׀ עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־ יְהוָ֥ה לֹֽא־ יִשְׁמָר־ עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא׀ שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃

passages.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents by Solomon.
God gives sleep to those He loves.
It is useless for you to get up early.
It is useless for you to stay up late.
It is useless for you to work hard for food.
God provides rest for His beloved people.
passages.original: שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם׀ מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵי ק֡וּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי־ שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִֽידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃

passages.text: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
passages.sermon:
Children come from the LORD.
The LORD gives children as a heritage.
Children are a gift from God.
The fruit of the womb is a reward from the LORD.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃

passages.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
passages.sermon: A warrior holds arrows in his hand.\r\nChildren born in youth are like these arrows.\r\nChildren give strength and purpose, just as arrows do for a warrior.
passages.original: כְּחִצִּ֥ים בְּיַד־ גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃

passages.text: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
passages.sermon:
A man who has many children is blessed.
Children are a gift from the LORD.
A man with many children fills his quiver with them.
He will not be put to shame.
He will face his enemies at the gate.
He will stand strong with his children.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־ אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־ יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־ אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
